name: pstack-docs
description: pstack docs: write by technical-writing → fact check against the code (codex) → edit by unslop (needs the pstack skills)

steps.name: write
prompt: Read the code the doc covers, and run the commands it will show; for a subsystem you don't know, pstack's how skill sits beside this one. Pick the doc's mode (tutorial, how-to, reference or explanation), write or update it where the project keeps its docs, and commit. Change nothing but docs.
again: Fix each, or say why the doc is right, and commit.

steps.name: fact-check
steps.label: fact check
prompt: Check the doc change, git diff {{base}}, against the code: every symbol, flag, path and command must exist and behave as written. Run what you can without writing. Read only: change no files. Report only statements that are wrong, at most 8, each with its file and line and what is true.
again: The writer has worked through your findings. Check git diff {{base}} against the code again: is every statement now true? At most 8.

steps.name: edit
prompt: Edit the doc change, git diff {{base}}, for its reader by the skill: one mode per doc, the short everyday word, no AI tells. Read only: change no files. Quote each line to change and give its rewrite, at most 10; a style you merely prefer is no finding.
